cnTitle: 流年大耗怎么看：大破财年先守后耗，把被动损变成主动花
enTitle: When Da Hao Appears: Guard First in a Major-Spending Year
enDesc: Da Hao governs large expenses, investment losses and unexpected bills in a year of big cash swings. Cut leverage, avoid high-risk bets and large loans, and meet the energy with planned, necessary spending.
cnDesc: 大耗主大额支出、投资亏损与意外开销，这一年钱容易大进大出；宜降低杠杆、回避高风险投资和大额借出，用计划内的必要支出主动应耗。

cnTitle: 流年伏兵怎么看：事情卡在暗处，把话摊开就少踩坑
enTitle: When Fu Bing Appears: Things Stall in the Dark; Bring Them Into the Open
enDesc: Fu Bing governs hidden obstacles, delays, quiet disputes and last-minute changes, with trouble concealed from view. Put agreements in writing, keep processes transparent and double-check rather than relying on words or hope.
cnDesc: 伏兵主暗中阻碍、拖延、隐性口舌与临门生变，这一年麻烦多藏在看不见处；宜把约定写清楚、流程走明、多核对，别靠口头和侥幸。

cnTitle: 流年六合怎么看：和合撮合的一年，利谈判结盟，仍要守边界
enTitle: When Liu He Appears: A Year of Harmony and Matchmaking, Favoring Talks and Alliances
enDesc: Liu He governs harmony, matchmaking, negotiation and alliances, making relationships easier to agree on and resistance lighter. Yet harmony rests on fair terms; with malefics or one-sided concessions, a deal plants hidden problems.
cnDesc: 六合主人缘和合、合作撮合、谈判与说媒，这一年关系容易谈拢、阻力偏小；但和合靠的是把条件摆公平，若逢煞忌或一味迁就，合作也会埋雷。

cnTitle: 流年贵神怎么看：贵人提携年，机会给你但不替你成事
enTitle: When Gui Shen Appears: A Year of Mentors Who Open Doors, Not Do the Work
enDesc: Gui Shen governs mentors, public opportunities, recognition and referrals, so someone tends to help at a key moment. Yet a mentor offers a stepping stone, not the result; standing on it still depends on preparation, and malefics discount the help.
cnDesc: 贵神主贵人提携、公开机遇、功名与引荐，这一年关键时刻容易有人拉一把；但贵人给的是台阶，能不能站稳仍看实力与准备，逢煞忌则贵人缘打折。

cnTitle: 流年将军怎么看：威权与竞争增强，把气势用在带队而非争胜
enTitle: When Jiang Jun Appears: Authority and Competition Rise; Lead, Do Not Just Win
enDesc: Jiang Jun is a Bo Shi sign governing authority, competition, execution and the bearing to lead, so personal drive is strong and responsibility tends to find you. Aim that edge at the goal and guard against rigidity, one-upmanship and refusing advice.
cnDesc: 将军属博士神煞，主威权、竞争、执行与带队伍的气势，这一年个人魄力强、容易被推到负责位置；关键是把锋芒对准目标，防过刚、争强与听不进意见。

cnTitle: 流年喜神怎么看：喜庆舒展的一年，喜事也要主动伸手接
enTitle: When Xi Shen Appears: A Year of Joy and Relief, But Happy Events Must Be Met
enDesc: Xi Shen governs joy, weddings and births, an open heart and good beginnings, making the mood smoother and smiles more common. Yet joy means conditions improve and still needs action to become real; malefics discount it.
cnDesc: 喜神主喜庆、婚嫁添丁、心情舒展与好事开端，这一年气氛偏顺、笑容比平时多；但喜事是「条件变好」，仍要主动表态和落实，逢煞忌则喜力打折。

cnTitle: 流年灾煞怎么看：突发意外偏急，提前排查、慢一步就少大半
enTitle: When Zai Sha Appears: Sudden Mishaps Favor Caution; Inspect Early and Slow Down
enDesc: Zai Sha governs sudden accidents, minor blood injuries, natural mishaps and abrupt disruptions that arrive fast and hard. Do safety checks early, slow at key moments and keep insurance adequate, and most sudden risks can be avoided.
cnDesc: 灾煞主突发意外、血光、自然灾害与急冲的波折，性质来得急、难预料；这一年宜把安全检查做在前、重要节点慢一步、保险留足，多数急险能避开。

cnTitle: 流年亡神怎么看：失神与暗损，守得住心神就破不了局
enTitle: When Wang Shen Appears: Losing Focus and Hidden Drain; Guard the Mind and the Plan Holds
enDesc: Wang Shen governs loss of focus, hidden drain, mental fog and plans quietly undermined, making attention slip and judgment waver. The focus is regular rest, disciplined process and more checks rather than forcing through.
cnDesc: 亡神主失神、暗损、精神恍惚与计划被暗中破坏，这一年容易注意力下滑、判断走样、被人钻空子；重点是规律作息、守住流程、多核对，不靠硬撑。

cnTitle: 2026廉贞化忌在命宫：情绪打结的一年，学会就事论事
enTitle: 2026 Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Life Palace: A Year of Tangled Emotions, Learned One Issue at a Time
enDesc: Lian Zhen carries the energy of confinement, and in the Life Palace this year you tend to fixate, limit yourself and react when emotion rises. The point is not suppression but finding an outlet, separating people from issues and practicing taking things one at a time.
cnDesc: 廉贞化气为囚，落命宫这一年容易钻牛角尖、自我设限、情绪一上头就冲动；重点不是压住自己，而是给情绪找出口、把人和事分开，慢慢练就事论事。

cnTitle: 2026廉贞化忌在夫妻宫：感情里的掌控与猜忌，靠坦诚和边界化解
enTitle: 2026 Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Spouse Palace: Control and Suspicion in Love, Resolved by Honesty and Boundaries
enDesc: Lian Zhen is a secondary romance star with the energy of confinement, and in the Spouse Palace this year relationships tend to tangle with strong control and inner drain over ambiguity or cold silence. Speak the unease openly, keep boundaries and avoid unclear involvements.
cnDesc: 廉贞为次桃花、化气为囚，落夫妻宫这一年感情易纠结、掌控欲强、遇暧昧或冷战便内耗；重点是把不安说开、守住彼此边界，远离不清不楚的关系。

cnTitle: 2026廉贞化忌在官禄宫：职场纠纷与职务压力，靠流程合规和留痕过关
enTitle: 2026 Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Career Palace: Workplace Disputes and Role Pressure, Cleared by Compliance and Records
enDesc: Lian Zhen governs rules with the energy of confinement, and in the Career Palace this year you may meet workplace disputes, complaints, unclear role boundaries and stuck processes. Follow regulations, keep complete records and use proper channels rather than forcing a clash.
cnDesc: 廉贞主规矩、化气为囚，落官禄宫这一年易遇职场纠纷、被投诉举报、职务边界不清与流程卡壳；重点是按规章办事、把资料留全、沟通走正规渠道，不硬碰。

cnTitle: 2026廉贞化忌在交友宫：朋友同事易拖累反目，先小人后君子
enTitle: 2026 Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Friends Palace: Friends and Colleagues May Let You Down; Settle Terms First
enDesc: With Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Friends Palace, friends and colleagues may let you down or fall out over money or feelings, and verbal cooperation can turn later. Put rules and accounts first rather than sparing face, and relationships last longer.
cnDesc: 廉贞化忌落交友宫，这一年易遇朋友同事拖累、因财因情反目、合作口头说清事后翻脸；重点是把规则和账讲在前面、不碍于面子，关系反而走得长。

cnTitle: 2026廉贞化忌在迁移宫：外出多是非与磕碰，慢行、留据、防被骗
enTitle: 2026 Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Travel Palace: Outside Brings Disputes and Knocks; Go Slow, Keep Records and Guard Against Fraud
enDesc: With Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Travel Palace, going outside this year may bring disputes, knocks, unfavorable contract terms or fraud as the outer environment tightens. Keep margin in plans, read key terms and secure documents rather than chasing small gains.
cnDesc: 廉贞化忌落迁移宫，这一年外出易遇是非、磕碰、合同条款吃亏或被骗，外部环境偏紧绷；重点是行程留余量、重要约定看条款、证件票据存好，不贪小便宜。

cnTitle: 2026廉贞化忌在福德宫：精神内耗偏重，学会给心事松绑、肯求助
enTitle: 2026 Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Karma Palace: Heavier Mental Strain; Learn to Unbind Thoughts and Seek Help
enDesc: With Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Karma Palace, this year you tend to ruminate and fixate with lower sleep and mood, as if thoughts are locked. Reduce self-pressure, keep regular rest, speak the trouble out and seek professional support when needed.
cnDesc: 廉贞化忌落福德宫，这一年容易反复想、钻想不开、睡眠与情绪偏低落，心事像被锁住；重点是降低自我施压、规律作息、把困扰说出来，必要时寻求专业帮助。

cnTitle: 2026廉贞化忌在财帛宫：因钱生困的一年，控杠杆、慢决策
enTitle: 2026 Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Wealth Palace: A Year of Money Pressure; Control Leverage and Decide Slowly
enDesc: With Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Wealth Palace, this year you may feel money anxiety, struggle with investments, face large expenses or lockups and weigh gains too heavily. Cut leverage, avoid speculation you do not understand and keep decisions buffered, prioritizing stability.
cnDesc: 廉贞化忌落财帛宫，这一年容易因钱焦虑、投资纠结、大额支出或被套、对得失看得过重；重点是降杠杆、不碰看不懂的投机、决策留缓冲，财务以稳为主。

cnTitle: 2026廉贞化忌在田宅宫：家宅易生纠纷与隐患，合同看清、安全查细
enTitle: 2026 Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Property Palace: Home and Property Disputes; Read Contracts and Check Safety
enDesc: With Lian Zhen Hua Ji in the Property Palace, this year may bring real-estate contract disputes, repair and electrical risks at home and friction with family or neighbors. Read sale and rental terms fully, check fire, water and electricity carefully and communicate rather than clash.
cnDesc: 廉贞化忌落田宅宫，这一年易遇房产合同纠纷、家中修缮电路隐患、与家人或邻里摩擦；重点是买卖租赁条款看全、水火用电检查做细、多沟通少硬碰。

cnTitle: 2026文昌化科在命宫：名声与文采被点亮，把表达练成个人招牌
enTitle: 2026 Wen Chang Hua Ke in the Life Palace: Reputation and Eloquence Light Up; Make Expression Your Signature
enDesc: Wen Chang governs learning, documents and formal recognition, and Hua Ke in the Life Palace brings clear thinking, polished expression and visibility and trust this year. Build your work and professional image while minding document details rather than growing careless with ease.
cnDesc: 文昌主才学、文书与正统功名，化科落命宫这一年思路清晰、表达得体、容易被人看见与信任；重点是把作品和专业形象立起来，同时留意文书细节、不因顺而草率。

cnTitle: 2026文昌化科在官禄宫：专业名声与晋升运，利考证、技术与文书岗
enTitle: 2026 Wen Chang Hua Ke in the Career Palace: Professional Reputation and Promotion, Favoring Credentials, Technical and Document Roles
enDesc: With Wen Chang Hua Ke in the Career Palace, professional performance is recognized this year, favoring credentials, promotion and the approval of documents and plans. Standardize qualifications and results, hit deadlines and ground reputation in real responsibilities.
cnDesc: 文昌化科落官禄宫，这一年职场上专业表现易被肯定、利考证晋升、文书与方案容易通过；重点是把资格和成果做规范、节点抓准，把名声落到实际职责上。

cnTitle: 2026文昌化科在父母宫：考试、师长与文书契约，走正规渠道最顺
enTitle: 2026 Wen Chang Hua Ke in the Parents Palace: Exams, Mentors and Documents Go Best Through Proper Channels
enDesc: The Parents Palace is the document and mentor position, and Wen Chang Hua Ke there favors exams, applications, contracts and senior support this year when materials are standard and channels proper. Submit by the rules and read contract terms.
cnDesc: 父母宫为文书位、师长位，文昌化科落此这一年利考试、申请、签约与长辈提携，材料规范、渠道正规则事半功倍；重点是按规矩递交、把契约条款看清。

cnTitle: 2026文昌化科在财帛宫：以名生财、靠文书合同进财的一年
enTitle: 2026 Wen Chang Hua Ke in the Wealth Palace: Earning Through Reputation and Documents
enDesc: With Wen Chang Hua Ke in the Wealth Palace, income tends to come through professional reputation, documents, contracts, copyright and credentials this year. Standardize cooperation and contract terms, protect standing and avoid money from unclear sources.
cnDesc: 文昌化科落财帛宫，这一年容易靠专业名声、文书合同、版权与资格带来收入，名声能变现；重点是把合作与合同条款做规范，守住口碑，不赚来路不清的钱。

cnTitle: 煞星庙旺和落陷破法有何不同：一个急而有力，一个别扭内耗
enTitle: How Malefics Differ in Exaltation Versus Fall: Sharp Force Versus Awkward Drain
enDesc: The same malefic in exaltation carries sharp, concentrated force that may strike or drive a breakthrough, while in fall it turns awkward and becomes inner drain and repetition. Telling the two apart keeps the remedy pointed the right way.
cnDesc: 同样一颗煞星，庙旺时力量急而集中，常表现为冲击也可能是爆发力；落陷时力量别扭、易成内耗与反复。分清这两种状态，化解的方向才不会用反。

cnTitle: 怎么看破财的年份与应期：先定薄弱环节，再用流月收窄时间窗
enTitle: How to Read the Year and Timing of Financial Loss: Find the Weak Link, Then Narrow It by Month
enDesc: Reading loss is not a flat prediction of losing money this year. First find the weak combination around Wealth and Property, use decade and annual transformations to set the year and monthly transformations to narrow the window, then do early risk control to minimize loss.
cnDesc: 看破财不是凭一句「今年破财」，而是先找财帛、田宅三方的薄弱组合，再用大限与流年四化定年份、流月四化收窄到具体时段，提前做风控就能把损失降到最低。

cnTitle: 本命、大限、流年三层四化相反时怎么裁决：分层看，别平均用力
enTitle: When Natal, Decade and Annual Transformations Conflict: Read in Layers, Not Evenly
enDesc: When natal Lu meets a decade Ji and an annual Lu, the conflicting signals confuse. The key is layering: natal transformations set the lifelong tone, decade transformations set the ten-year stage and annual transformations only set the year trigger, with different weight rather than an even average.
cnDesc: 本命禄、大限忌、流年又禄，信号相反时最容易乱。裁决的关键是分层：生年四化定一生底色、大限四化定十年阶段、流年四化只定当年触发，权重不同，不能混在一起平均算。

cnTitle: 怎么看一个人会不会大器晚成：看主轴星是否晚发、后段大限是否走强
enTitle: How to Tell If Someone Blooms Late: Late-Opening Axis Stars and Stronger Later Decades
enDesc: Blooming late is not mere comfort; it can be read in the chart: whether the axis stars open late, whether early decades accumulate, whether later decades strengthen in the triple-direction and whether transformations activate later, taken together.
cnDesc: 大器晚成不是安慰话，盘上有迹可循：主轴星是否偏内敛晚发、中青年大限是否在积累、后半段大限是否三方转强、四化是否在后段引动，合起来才好判断。

cnTitle: 天同、天梁型人配什么伴侣：一个怕被琐事绑住，一个需要被需要
enTitle: What Tian Tong and Tian Liang Types Need in a Partner: Freedom From Trivia and the Sense of Being Needed
enDesc: Tian Tong values comfort and feeling and dislikes worry, while Tian Liang values care and principle and tends to carry matters. The key for both is a partner who meets the emotions or shares responsibility without taking the giving and conceding for granted.
cnDesc: 天同重享受与情绪、怕操心，天梁重照顾与原则、爱扛事，这两类人找伴侣的关键是有人接住情绪或分担责任，又不把自己的付出与退让当成理所当然。

cnTitle: 天机、天相型人配什么伴侣：一个要能商量，一个要讲规则
enTitle: What Tian Ji and Tian Xiang Types Need in a Partner: Room to Talk Things Over and Clear Rules
enDesc: Tian Ji governs thought, change and deliberation, while Tian Xiang governs steadiness, coordination and rules. The key for both is a partner who talks things through, respects rules and pace and gives the changing or worrying mind some stability.
cnDesc: 天机主动脑、善变、爱琢磨，天相主稳重、协调、讲规矩，这两类人找伴侣的关键是有人能一起商量、尊重规则与节奏，又能给多变或多虑的心一份安定。

cnTitle: 廉贞、巨门型人配什么伴侣：一个要坦诚，一个要能接住口角与情绪
enTitle: What Lian Zhen and Ju Men Types Need in a Partner: Honesty and the Ability to Handle Words and Emotion
enDesc: Lian Zhen governs complexity, rules and control, while Ju Men governs expression, words and suspicion, bringing larger ups and downs. The key is a partner honest enough to talk things through, neither avoiding conflict nor holding grudges.
cnDesc: 廉贞主复杂、规矩与掌控，巨门主表达、口舌与多疑，这两类人感情里起伏偏大，关键是找一个足够坦诚、能把话讲开、不回避冲突也不记仇的人。

cnTitle: 婚姻危机、离婚风险的信号怎么看：重在提前识别、及时修复
enTitle: How to Read Signs of Marriage Crisis and Divorce Risk: Early Recognition and Timely Repair
enDesc: Reading marriage risk is not a verdict on divorce but recognizing prolonged communication breakdown, drifting values, a third party or overload of real-world pressure, then communicating, repairing or seeking professional marriage counseling while the issue is small.
cnDesc: 盘上看婚姻风险，不是断言离不离，而是识别沟通长期失温、价值观渐行渐远、第三方介入或现实压力过载等信号，趁问题还小及时沟通、修复或寻求专业婚姻咨询。

cnTitle: 怎么判断对方是不是正缘：看相处的稳定与价值观，而非一时心跳
enTitle: How to Judge Whether Someone Is the Right Partner: Stability and Values Over a Racing Heart
enDesc: The right partner is not the one who makes the heart race most but the one with steady feelings, aligned values, the ability to solve problems together and willingness to commit long term. Read the Spouse Palace and triple-direction, but in reality watch the relationship over time.
cnDesc: 正缘不是心跳最快的那个，而是相处下来情绪稳定、价值观合得来、遇事能一起解决、彼此都愿意长期投入的人；盘上看夫妻宫与三方，现实里更要看长时间的相处。

cnTitle: 再婚、二婚的盘怎么看：先看清前段的功课，再看当下的现实基础
enTitle: How to Read Remarriage: First See the Lessons of the Earlier Relationship, Then the Present Foundation
enDesc: Reading remarriage is not comparing who is better but whether the lessons of the earlier relationship are complete, whether present values and real conditions are solid and whether children and old matters can be handled. Read the Spouse Palace and decade, but in reality watch honesty and steady effort.
cnDesc: 看再婚不是比较谁更好，而是看前段关系留下的功课是否完成、当下两人的价值观与现实条件是否扎实、能否处理好子女与旧事，盘上看夫妻宫与大限，现实里更看坦诚与经营。

cnTitle: 辅弼夹帝、夹命格怎么看：助力环绕的稳，仍需主星自己有力
enTitle: The Pattern of Fu Bi Flanking the Emperor or Life: Surrounding Support That Still Needs a Strong Core Star
enDesc: When Zuo Fu and You Bi flank the Life Palace or Zi Wei from either side, support stays present with people helping from beside and steadier progress. Yet they flank as assistants and the core star must stand on its own, while gathered malefics and emptiness discount the help.
cnDesc: 左辅右弼一前一后夹命或夹紫微，主一生助力不断、有人从旁成全、做事比别人多些稳当；但夹的是「辅」，主星自己得立得住，逢煞聚空劫则助力打折。

cnTitle: 左右守垣格是真格还是穿凿：出现条件太宽，需辨明
enTitle: Is Zuo You Shou Yuan a Real Pattern or Forced? Its Conditions Are Too Broad, So Examine It
enDesc: Rhyme calls it a pattern when Zuo Fu and You Bi guard the Life Palace, but the two arrange by year stem with broad conditions that many charts can meet, so naming it a pattern on that alone is forced. See whether the core star, triple-direction and transformations support it before counting it.
cnDesc: 口诀把左辅右弼守命称「左右守垣格」，但二星随年干排列、出现条件宽，很多盘都能沾边，单凭此称格容易穿凿；本站建议看主星、三方与四化是否配合，再决定算不算。

cnTitle: 交友宫怎么看：看朋友、同事与人脉，也看合伙与人际边界
enTitle: How to Read the Friends Palace: Friends, Colleagues and Networks, Plus Partnership Boundaries
enDesc: The Friends Palace governs friends, colleagues, subordinates and peer networks, and also reflects how you move in groups and whom to trust or partner with. Read the major star for tone, then combine triple-direction and transformations to see which relationships help and which need boundaries.
cnDesc: 交友宫（奴仆宫）管朋友、同事、下属与平辈人脉，也反映一个人怎么在群体里相处、值不值得深交与合伙；读法是先看主星定基调，再合三方、四化，分清哪些关系是助力、哪些要守边界。

cnTitle: 三台八座星是什么：主地位、贵气与公开场合的分量
enTitle: What Are San Tai and Ba Zuo: Status, Nobility and Weight in Public Settings
enDesc: San Tai and Ba Zuo are a paired pair of assistant stars governing nobility, status, steadiness and weight in public, favoring public office, management and roles needing seniority and reputation. They are supporting stars that rely on a strong core star and auspicious meetings, while malefics leave an empty name.
cnDesc: 三台、八座是成对的辅曜，主贵气、地位、稳重与公开场合的分量，利公职、管理与需要资历声望的岗位；它们是「衬托」的星，要依附有力主星与吉会才发挥，逢煞忌则虚名。

cnTitle: 天官星是什么：主贵气、官职与事业名声，常与天福同宫
enTitle: What Is Tian Guan: Nobility, Office and Career Reputation, Often With Tian Fu
enDesc: Tian Guan is an assistant star governing nobility, office, career reputation and dignity in work, often meeting Tian Fu which governs blessing and longevity, and favoring steady, reputable professions. It relies on a strong core star and auspicious meetings, while malefics discount the nobility.
cnDesc: 天官是辅曜，主贵气、官职、事业名声与做事的体面，常与天福（主福禄寿）同宫相会，利稳定、有声望的职业；它要依附有力主星与吉会，逢煞忌则贵气打折。

cnTitle: 别人找你借钱怎么办：情分与规则分开，量力而行、写清借条
enTitle: What to Do When Someone Asks to Borrow Money: Separate Goodwill From Rules, Lend Within Means and Write a Note
enDesc: Before lending, separate urgent relief from chronic need or investment and assess what you can bear. Lending is goodwill while a written note and repayment terms are rules, and keeping them apart protects both the relationship and yourself.
cnDesc: 借钱给别人，先分清是救急、救穷还是投资，再评估自己的承受力；肯借是情分，写借条、定还款方式是规则，两者分开，既不伤感情也不拖垮自己。

cnTitle: 给人做担保怎么看：连带责任不轻，先看对方还款力再决定
enTitle: How to Read Guaranteeing for Someone: Joint Liability Is Serious; Check Repayment Ability First
enDesc: Guaranteeing is more than a signature; most guarantees carry joint repayment liability, and if the other side cannot pay the debt comes to you. Before deciding, check repayment ability, the loan purpose and contract terms, and avoid signing when you can.
cnDesc: 担保不是签个名那么简单，多数担保要承担连带还款责任，对方还不上时账会落到自己头上；决定前先看对方的还款能力、借款用途与合同条款，能不签尽量不签。

cnTitle: 健康大运、健康关口怎么看：看倾向与节奏，提前体检、正规就医
enTitle: How to Read Health Stages and Critical Windows: Tendencies and Timing, With Early Checkups and Formal Care
enDesc: Reading health in the chart means seeing constitutional tendencies, the systems to mind and which stages look tighter, reminding you to do early checkups and keep regular habits rather than diagnosing or frightening yourself. Any discomfort relies on formal hospital exams and diagnosis.
cnDesc: 盘上看健康，是看体质倾向、需要留意的系统与哪些大限流年偏紧，提醒你提前体检、规律作息，而不是断病或吓自己；任何不适都以正规医院的检查和诊断为准。

cnTitle: 紫微为什么有时准、有时不准：方法、定盘与概率的边界
enTitle: Why Zi Wei Dou Shu Seems Accurate at Times and Not Others: Method, Rectification and the Bounds of Probability
enDesc: It seems accurate mostly when information is clear, the question specific and the chart rectified; it seems off when the time is wrong, the question too broad or tendencies are taken as verdicts. Understanding it as a tool for structure and probability keeps you from judging by one or two results.
cnDesc: 觉得有时准，多半是信息清楚、问题具体、定盘准确；觉得不准，常是时辰有误、问得太宽或把倾向当成了定论。理解它是一套看结构与概率的工具，就不会因一两次得失下判断。

cnTitle: 紫微能改命吗：盘给倾向、行为改结果，分清改命与改运
enTitle: Can Zi Wei Dou Shu Change Fate? The Chart Gives Tendencies and Behavior Changes Results
enDesc: The chart cannot change the baseline you were born with, but once you see the structure, choices, habits and actions gradually change results, closer to changing luck and yourself than changing fate. Rather than pursuing a changed fate, turn insight into long-term action.
cnDesc: 盘改不了出生的底色，但看清结构后，选择、习惯与行动会一点点改变结果，这更接近「改运、改自己」而非「改命」。与其追求改命，不如把认知变成长期的行动。
